Saerenthis is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. He is a Naga that serves Tsovinar.

sections.title: In-Game Appearance
sections.content: Saerenthis first appeared in the Frontier Rift stage “Drowning Darkness,” and his lore is further expanded upon in the Grand Quest “Fates of the Fallen.”

sections.title: Background
sections.content: Saerenthis is a part of the subservient race of Naga commanded by the Goddess of the Endless Abyss, Tsovinar. He is the high priest of Tsovinar, and the most powerful of the Naga. He wields the skull of his deceased Father, which he named Uln'gha.

sections.title: History
sections.content: Saerenthis was sent forth from the Endless Abyss in order to begin the conquest of Aimhyr. Saerenthis begins his journey toward conquest by attempting to kill Baelfyr, but is unsuccessful. He eventually made his way to The Vale using information from Baelfyr, and encounters Tevarius, an ancient storm-born dragon in human form. Tevarius proceeds to wreak havoc on the Naga, killing most of the ones that had accompanied Saerenthis. Saerenthis and the remaining Naga leave, retreating in order to allow Baelfyr to slaughter his own people, as he now deems the entirety of the human race to be “unclean.” The Wolfseye Guard, continuing to slaughter the innocent, are intercepted by the Naga who then protect the people, get them to safety, and kill the Wolfseye Guard. Saerenthis, using his persuasive skills, brings the rescued people of Aimhyr down to the Abyss, and gives a sermon about the great Goddess of the Endless Abyss, Tsovinar. The people, without knowing the gravity of the situation, pledged themselves to Tsovinar. Though not explicitly mentioned, it is implied that these people became Naga. Tevarius and Sero-Anya are chased by Naga until they reach the Pagoda of N’an Wang. Saerenthis follows, and learns of the River Di’Yu, planning instead to use its power to bring forth Tsovinar. Before he can execute this plan, Saerenthis faces off against N’an Wang, but her magic is useless against him. Directly after, in an explosive battle, Tevarius kill Saerenthis with a massive thunder strike called forth from the heavens.

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content: - Uln'gha is a conglomerate of phrases in R’lyehian, the language of Cthulhu and also the language of the Naga in Brave Frontier. It translates roughly to “That which summons Death.”

'''Saerenthis''' is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. He is a Naga that serves [[Tsovinar (character)|Tsovinar]].
==In-Game Appearance==
Saerenthis first appeared in the Frontier Rift stage “Drowning Darkness,” and his lore is further expanded upon in the Grand Quest “Fates of the Fallen.”

==Background==
Saerenthis is a part of the subservient race of Naga commanded by the Goddess of the Endless Abyss, Tsovinar. He is the high priest of Tsovinar, and the most powerful of the Naga. He wields the skull of his deceased Father, which he named [[Uln'gha]].

==History==
Saerenthis was sent forth from the Endless Abyss in order to begin the conquest of Aimhyr. Saerenthis begins his journey toward conquest by attempting to kill [[Baelfyr (character)|Baelfyr]], but is unsuccessful. He eventually made his way to The Vale using information from Baelfyr, and encounters Tevarius, an ancient storm-born dragon in human form. Tevarius proceeds to wreak havoc on the Naga, killing most of the ones that had accompanied Saerenthis. Saerenthis and the remaining Naga leave, retreating in order to allow Baelfyr to slaughter his own people, as he now deems the entirety of the human race to be “unclean.” The Wolfseye Guard, continuing to slaughter the innocent, are intercepted by the Naga who then protect the people, get them to safety, and kill the Wolfseye Guard. Saerenthis, using his persuasive skills, brings the rescued people of Aimhyr down to the Abyss, and gives a sermon about the great Goddess of the Endless Abyss, Tsovinar. The people, without knowing the gravity of the situation, pledged themselves to Tsovinar. Though not explicitly mentioned, it is implied that these people became Naga. Tevarius and [[Sero-Anya (character)|Sero-Anya]] are chased by Naga until they reach the Pagoda of N’an Wang. Saerenthis follows, and learns of the River Di’Yu, planning instead to use its power to bring forth Tsovinar. Before he can execute this plan, Saerenthis faces off against N’an Wang, but her magic is useless against him. Directly after, in an explosive battle, Tevarius kill Saerenthis with a massive thunder strike called forth from the heavens.
